summary: basement hangs Two fiddling fish Wrapped in YinYang Pandas In Green Ironman, of Cal, not Tony Machine Elephant eyes glean eclectic stare while #33 Celtic flys in air And a two headed turtle Struggles To nowhere. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
basement
hangs
Two fiddling fish
Wrapped in YinYang
Pandas
In Green
Ironman, of
Cal, not Tony
Machine
Elephant eyes glean
eclectic stare
while #33
Celtic flys in air
And a two headed turtle
Struggles
To nowhere.
#smallpoems
